questions.question: Why shouldn't you use an array index as a 'key' for lists in React when the item order can change?
options: Because React forbids numbers as keys
Because it breaks Reconciliation, causing React to retain stale component state and degrading performance
Because array index keys only work in production builds
Because it immediately causes a browser out-of-memory crash
questions.explanation: When items are inserted, deleted, or reordered, their indices shift, causing React to misidentify DOM nodes and attach old internal state to the wrong items.
questions.card_front: Why shouldn't you use an array index as a 'key' for lists in React when the item order can change?
questions.card_back: Because it breaks Reconciliation, causing React to retain stale component state and degrading performance

questions.question: What is the difference between useMemo and useCallback in React?
options: useMemo memoizes the computed return value of a function, whereas useCallback memoizes the function reference itself
useMemo runs asynchronously whereas useCallback runs synchronously
useCallback is for class components whereas useMemo is for function components
questions.explanation: useMemo(() => compute(a, b), [a, b]) caches the calculated value, while useCallback(fn, deps) caches the function instance itself to prevent creating a new reference on every render.
questions.card_front: What is the difference between useMemo and useCallback in React?
questions.card_back: useMemo memoizes the computed return value of a function, whereas useCallback memoizes the function reference itself

questions.question: What does the Higher-Order Component `React.memo(MyComponent)` do?
options: Skips re-rendering the component if its props have not changed (via shallow comparison)
Automatically calls an API when the component mounts
questions.explanation: React.memo performs a shallow comparison of previous and next props; if they are equal, it skips re-rendering the child component.
questions.card_front: What does the Higher-Order Component `React.memo(MyComponent)` do?
questions.card_back: Skips re-rendering the component if its props have not changed (via shallow comparison)
